annotations.rationale: Specific disease name used as a modifier of the head noun 'gene' that follows the parenthetical DMD.
Abbreviation defining the long form Duchenne muscular dystrophy; the abbreviation is a separate synonymous mention of the same specific disease.
The word 'disease' is a very general term and 'genetic disease' refers generically to a class of diseases rather than one named disease, so it should not be annotated.
'Muscular dystrophy' names a family of multiple specific diseases (Duchenne, Becker, Emery-Dreifuss), so it is a Disease Class.
'mdx' is the name of a mutant mouse strain/allele used as a model of muscular dystrophy rather than a disease name; included under the some-reading rule but excluded as an organism/model name.
Abbreviation of Duchenne muscular dystrophy used as a modifier of 'locus'; refers to the DMD locus, included under the some-reading rule.
Mutant mouse name 'mdx' referring to the model of muscular dystrophy rather than a disease name; included as a possible disease reference but excluded as an organism/model name.
'Becker muscular dystrophy' is one specific disease form with a defined meaning; the following word 'type' is not part of the mention.
Mutant mouse name 'mdx' used for a genetic linkage locus rather than a disease name; included under the some-reading rule but excluded as an organism/model name.
Mutant mouse name 'mdx' modifying 'mutation'; it is not a disease name and is excluded as an organism/model name.
Named specific disease (Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy) with a single definition; the whole string is preferred.
annotations.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease) and 5 (Minimum necessary span)

annotations.rationale: Abbreviation used as a modifier of 'cDNA clone'; refers to the DMD gene sequence, included under the some-reading rule.

Name of a mouse mutant phenotype (spf) rather than a human disease; included as a possible disease under some reading but excluded as an organism/model name.
Abbreviation (synonym) of 'sparse fur', a mouse mutant name rather than a disease name; excluded as an organism/model name.
Abbreviation of Duchenne muscular dystrophy used as a noun phrase referring to the DMD locus linked to OTC; included under the some-reading rule.
